name: whoop
description: Ask Claude about your WHOOP recovery, sleep, strain and workouts.
long_description: Connects Claude to the WHOOP API v2 over OAuth 2.0. After a one-time browser login the extension can read your daily recovery scores (HRV, resting heart rate, SpO2, skin temperature), sleep activities with stage breakdowns and sleep performance, physiological cycles with day strain and calories, workouts with heart-rate zones, and your basic profile and body measurements. It also provides a one-call daily summary and a range summary with averages and trends. Tokens are stored locally and refreshed automatically; nothing is sent anywhere except api.prod.whoop.com.

client_id.title: WHOOP client ID
client_id.description: Client ID of your app at developer-dashboard.whoop.com.

client_secret.title: WHOOP client secret
client_secret.description: Client secret of the same WHOOP app.

log_level.description: debug, info, warn, error or silent. Logs go to stderr only.
